description: Get search term category insights for a campaign. Shows the search categories your ads appeared against (like the Insights panel in the Google Ads UI). Must query one campaign at a time. Optionally compares two date ranges to show trends.

campaign_id.description: The numeric string campaign ID to get insights for (required, one campaign at a time)

compare_end_date.description: Comparison period end date (optional, for trend calculation)

compare_start_date.description: Comparison period start date (optional, for trend calculation)

name: google_ads_search_term_insights
